sources.name: Police workforce England and Wales 30 September 2025
sources.semantic_limit: Force and neighbourhood-policing workforce context only; staffing levels do not establish parcel-level safety or incident risk.

sources.name: User guide to police workforce statistics
sources.semantic_limit: Definitions, revisions and data-quality conventions only; contains no parcel evidence and creates no score.

sources.name: HMICFRS PEEL police effectiveness efficiency and legitimacy assessments
sources.semantic_limit: Force-level inspection judgement only; grades are not local incident counts and must not be assigned directly to parcels.

sources.name: data.police.uk neighbourhood boundary API
sources.semantic_limit: Police-neighbourhood polygon QA only; the boundary is not a cadastral parcel boundary and does not prove exact incident location.

sources.name: data.police.uk stop and searches by area API
sources.semantic_limit: Approximate stop-search locations and person-related attributes are unsuitable for parcel scoring; retain no raw person-level fields and do not infer safety from absence.

sources.name: Police misconduct open data tables
sources.semantic_limit: Aggregate police-governance context only; misconduct statistics are not direct neighbourhood or parcel safety evidence.

scheduled_release_watch.source: Police Workforce England and Wales 31 March 2026
scheduled_release_watch.rule: Do not replace the 30 September 2025 release until the scheduled publication is actually available and read back.
